title: Section range in a continuous-function presentation
statement: Let E be a normed field, A a totally disconnected subring, Y a scheme, and N and Q internal continuous A-modules. Supply a continuous-function presentation c of Q with values E^r as in [def-sfb-continuous-function-module-presentation] and an internal morphism f:N→Q. Define its presented section range on B in Y_proet to be Set.range(x↦c_B(F_Y(f)_B(x))), where F_Y is the equivalence of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding]. This is the explicit range formula and its defining equality; there is no witness selected from an existence theorem.

def continuousFunctionPresentationRange
    {E : Type} [NormedField E] [IsTopologicalRing E]
    (A : Subring E) [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A] {Y : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ}
    {N Q : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A) Y)}
    (c : ContinuousFunctionPresentation Y A (Fin r → E) Q) (f : N ⟶ Q)
    (B : Y.ProEt) : Set C(B.left, Fin r → E)
lean.note: Concrete range of the supplied actual internal map, with its defining equality proved; no mathematical hypothesis or conclusion changes.
